chapter_title: Concerning why if a [Nail] is cut the Person shall not be sick; but if a Limb is cut he shall immediately be pained.
chapter_note: This chapter is carried almost entirely by a dialogue frame (disciple question → apostle answer → closing reaction). The only recoverable older teaching substrate is the correspondential/analogical explanation in ¶5 (body~earth; limbs~trees; regrowing vs non-regrowing kinds). No NT overlay appears; the frame is hagiographic/compilational rather than Christian-citation.

paragraphs.temporal_note: Formulaic dialogue setup: disciple questions the apostle; this is the Kephalaia’s hagiographic frame voice.
Direct-address question to “my master” in Q&A format; despite containing the problem statement (hair/nails vs limbs), it functions as framed petition rather than impersonal systematic exposition.
Explicit beseeching formula (“I besee[ch you], my master”) typical of the editorial Q&A container.
Dialogue attribution (“Then the a[postle] speaks…”) is a layer-2 frame marker; not part of the oldest substrate.

paragraphs.core_text: Happen you know th[at the] body is like the earth, wh[ile these] limbs als[o ...] of it are like the trees. There are varieties [...] of tree you shall find growing on the earth. They ar[is]e and grow again and stand firm. They have not [... ...] Again, there are others that if they are cut shall not [grow ...] and they grow, as they are li[ke ...] which shall be cut and grow [...] and [...] they too that occur [...] they shall be cut and not grow, resembling [... neither] grow nor shall they [... ...] it [sh]all please him on [...] and grows [...] in impurity [... ...] from him. This flesh that is corrupt [... ⟨p.282⟩ ...] in the liv[in]g flesh and they [... ...] are somewhat sick.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed the opening dialogue/self-referential instruction formula: “I am the one who will instruct you [about the less]on for which you have asked me!” This is the compiler’s Q&A scaffolding, not the impersonal teaching substance.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core substrate appears as an impersonal correspondential mapping within a natural/cosmic-style microcosm (body~earth; limbs~trees; kinds that regrow vs kinds that do not), without institutional application or Gospel citation. The paragraph is MIXED only because it is introduced by explicit Q&A self-reference.
Concluding ‘lesson delivered’ formula (“Behold, [I have tau/ght you]…”) is editorial closure rather than core exposition.
Audience reaction/scene management (“disciple heard… he sat down”) is narrative frame.
